# Maulie Cosmetics

> Maulie Cosmetics, powered by SRJ Formulation Pvt. Ltd., is a cosmetics and personal care manufacturer based in Kamothe, Navi Mumbai (Panvel), Maharashtra, India. It offers private label, third party (contract) and custom formulation manufacturing for brands, startups, distributors and hotels across India.

## Services
- Private label cosmetics manufacturing (your brand, label and packaging; flexible MOQs for startups)
- Third party / contract cosmetics manufacturing to the client's formula
- Custom skincare, haircare and personal care formulation
- Hotel amenity kits with logo branding

## Products manufactured
Face wash, face cream, face serum, sunscreen lotion, body lotion, lotion, cream, scrub, ointment, solution, shampoo, hair oil, body wash, hand wash, hygiene wash, toilet cleaner, and hotel amenity kits (comb, soap, body wash, body lotion, toothbrush, toothpaste).

## Locations
- Factory: Bathija Industries, Plot No. 205/206, Jawahar Co-op. Industrial Estate, Kamothe, Navi Mumbai 410209, Maharashtra, India
- Head office: Plot No. 234 A, Jawahar Co-op Industrial Estate, Kamothe, Panvel, Maharashtra 410209
- Serving: Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Panvel, Thane, Pune, Maharashtra and PAN India
